"She thought that she had trained enough for this moment. Her fighting skills were suitable against human opponents, not monstrous ones. In the dungeons of the palace, she got cornered by a Slug demon. Immediately it sprayed her with foul-smelling slime which made her clothes feel suffocating. As she scrambled to dodge and flee, the creature lurched forward and began to molest her. Its pheromones made quick work of her defences and she was helpless as the slug overpowered her. Its tentacles and phallus fondled and pleasured her drowsy form. She couldn't help feeling intense lust as she felt the warm, moist weight of the slug atop of her. Eventually she lost consciousness, only to awaken in a warm pool of slime that made her nerves tingle. The Slug began to swallow her whole, massaging her soft, smooth flesh to keep her calm and aroused. Once inside, the creature began the breeding process. She was not to be digested, but converted into another Slug demon. The transformation would be horrific but oddly pleasurable. A sad end for such a lovely woman."
